genomes.name: Managed Long
genomes.thesis: Long almost all the time: the only entry is a day without a volume blow-out, under 2.2 times average, which is nearly every day. The edge is in the exits: out on a close under the 50-day mean that is not oversold (z-score above -0.95), when the 14-day average range passes 4.4% of price, at a 6.4% gain, at a 4.25% loss or after 13 sessions, then back in two sessions later.
genomes.rationale: Bred in the second calm-trend island: generation 9, descended from Claude's 'Calm Trend, Managed' seed.
